# kurrentcloud_project (Resource)

Manages projects within an organization in Kurrent Cloud

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "kurrentcloud_project" "chicken_window" {
  name = "Improved Chicken Window"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

## Schema

### Required

- **name** (String) Human-friendly name for the project

### Optional

- **id** (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import kurrentcloud_project.example project_id
```
